q.ru: Выберите правильный вариант: She ___ to school every day.
q.uz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: She ___ to school every day.
q.en: Choose the correct option: She ___ to school every day.

e.ru: Present Simple, 3-е лицо ед. числа: goes.
e.en: Present Simple, third person singular: goes.

q.ru: Выберите правильный вариант: I have ___ apple.
q.uz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: I have ___ apple.
q.en: Choose the correct option: I have ___ apple.

e.en: Use an before a vowel sound.

q.ru: Какова форма Past Simple глагола go?
q.uz: go fe'lining Past Simple shakli qanday?
q.en: What is the Past Simple form of the verb go?

q.ru: Выберите правильный вариант: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
q.uz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
q.en: Choose the correct option: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.

e.ru: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + глагол.
e.uz: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + fe'l.
e.en: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + verb.

q.ru: Выберите правильный вариант: He has lived here ___ 2015.
q.uz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: He has lived here ___ 2015.
q.en: Choose the correct option: He has lived here ___ 2015.

e.ru: since — с указанием момента начала, for — с периодом.
e.uz: since — boshlanish payti bilan, for — davr bilan.
e.en: Use since with a starting point, for with a duration.

e.uz: large — katta, big ham shu ma'noda.
e.en: Large means the same as big.

q.ru: Выберите правильный вариант: The book ___ by millions of people.
q.uz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: The book ___ by millions of people.
q.en: Choose the correct option: The book ___ by millions of people.

e.ru: Present Perfect Passive: has been + V3.
e.uz: Present Perfect Passive: has been + V3.
e.en: Present Perfect Passive: has been + past participle.

q.ru: Выберите правильный вариант: I wish I ___ more time.
q.uz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: I wish I ___ more time.
q.en: Choose the correct option: I wish I ___ more time.

e.ru: После wish о настоящем используется Past Simple.
e.uz: Hozirgi zamon haqidagi wish dan keyin Past Simple ishlatiladi.
e.en: After wish about the present, use the Past Simple.

q.ru: Выберите правильный вариант: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
q.uz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
q.en: Choose the correct option: By the time we arrived, the film ___.

e.ru: Действие раньше другого прошлого действия — Past Perfect.
e.uz: Boshqa o'tgan harakatdan oldingi harakat — Past Perfect.
e.en: An action before another past action takes the Past Perfect.

q.ru: Выберите правильный вариант: She suggested ___ to the cinema.
q.uz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: She suggested ___ to the cinema.
q.en: Choose the correct option: She suggested ___ to the cinema.

e.ru: После suggest используется герундий: suggested going.
e.uz: suggest dan keyin gerund ishlatiladi: suggested going.
e.en: Suggest is followed by a gerund: suggested going.
